# NeedAWebsite

> NeedAWebsite is a Mumbai-based web design and development studio run by founder Tabish. It builds fast, mobile-friendly websites for small and medium businesses across India and prepares them to be found on Google and AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Perplexity (SEO, AEO and GEO).

## Key pages
- [Home](https://needawebsite.in/): Overview of services and proof of work
- [Services](https://needawebsite.in/services): Web design and development, AI search optimization, custom web apps
- [About](https://needawebsite.in/about): About the founder, Tabish
- [Contact](https://needawebsite.in/contact): Free quote form, phone and WhatsApp

## Tools
- [AI Visibility Scanner](https://aiscan.needawebsite.in): Free tool that checks how readable a website is to search engines and AI assistants

## Facts
- Location: Mumbai, India. Serves clients across India remotely.
- Phone: +91 9987455707, +91 9820795707
- One-page websites: delivered in about 5 days. Multi-page and custom builds: 4 to 8 weeks.
- Case study: Nourish by Neelam, a clinical and sports nutrition practice
